name: Padmanabh Alloy & Polymers Limited
about: Padmanabh Alloy & Polymers Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of filled and reinforced thermoplastic compounds and master batches products in India. It provides mineral filled thermoplastic, mineral master batches, synthetic paper master batches, glass reinforced thermoplastic, and other specialty master batches. The company also offers additive master batches for plastic processors. In addition, it provides general compounds, such as talc filled, calcium carbonate filled, glass reinforced, and walostonite filled polypropylene homopolymer and copolymer, as well as EPDM base HD/PP, polypropylene flame-retardant, and other tailormade PP compounds. Further, the company offers engineering plastic products, including glass reinforced nylon and ABS compounds, and polycarbonate-ABS blends and alloys; and masterbatches comprising anti-fibrillation, U.V. based, PP anti-stat, white, polypropylene based black, and other tailormade masterbatches. Its products are used in automobile, furniture, home appliances, electrical switches, and agriculture industries. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Surat, India.
